subject: aftf
title: AFI.TF.------STF.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 264 (CMBA-20). AFTF (affinity transfer) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; STF (source transfer) is the partner. The title names AFI-TF; the chart has no label for it. From the subject: TRS (transition), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", and MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: AFI-DY. From AFI-DY: ASP-ES (aspect essence). From ASP-ES: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", is on a dotted line from ASP-ES.
